summary: Phase 1 enhancement testing for Website Sekolah (SMA Negeri 1 Laguboti). Backend: 12/13 pytest tests passed (1 unrelated 404 on /api/dashboard/stats — actual endpoint is /api/stats, not in Phase 1 scope). Verified: login 401 wrong creds, 200 correct super admin, siswa user create defaults is_active=true, PATCH is_active=false blocks login with 403 'Akun Anda dinonaktifkan', re-activate restores login, password change persists, DELETE removes user. Super admin boassibarani123@gmail.com never deactivated. Frontend: All data-testid locators verified end-to-end via Playwright: login-error inline alert + Loader2 'Memproses...' spinner on wrong creds; 6 dashboard stat-card links (stat-card-total-siswa/-total-guru/-inventaris/-tugas-aktif/-mini-quiz/-post-schoolgram) navigate correctly; widget-presensi-link -> /attendance-recap and widget-pengumuman-link -> /announcements; pengumuman-empty state shown; header has profile-button + logout-button; profile-button -> /profile; profile page shows profile-name/profile-role-badge + working profile-tab-akademik/profile-tab-pribadi tabs; MasterAccounts filters (accounts-role-filter, accounts-status-filter, accounts-search) functional; create+edit+delete round trip with throwaway siswa account succeeded (edit-account-modal persisted name change, delete-confirm-modal + confirm-delete-button removed user, toast 'Akun dihapus' shown); logout-button returns to /login.

minor.issue: Returns 404; actual endpoint is /api/stats. Not in Phase 1 scope, test was incorrect — frontend uses /api/stats correctly.

issues: Edit modal does not close on Escape key (minor UX). X icon and Batal button work. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py update_user applies body.model_dump() keys only when non-None; is_active=false correctly survives because filter is 'is not None' — good.
Login 403 message 'Akun Anda dinonaktifkan. Hubungi administrator sekolah.' is clear and user-friendly.
Edit modal (MasterAccounts.jsx line 200) could benefit from Escape key handler and backdrop-click-to-close for consistency with delete-confirm-modal.

success_rate.backend: 92% (12/13; 1 failure was incorrect test endpoint, not an app bug)

seed_data_creation: Throwaway siswa accounts created and cleaned up per test (TEST_phase1_*@example.com, test_ui_*@example.com). All deleted at end of their respective tests. Super admin untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 fully verified. Backend is_active flow in server.py (UserUpdate line 535, create_user line 591, login 403 line 544) all working. Frontend data-testids all present: login-error, login-form-submit-button (with Loader2 'Memproses...'), stat-card-*, widget-presensi-link, widget-pengumuman-link, pengumuman-empty, profile-button, logout-button, profile-tab-akademik, profile-tab-pribadi, profile-akademik, profile-pribadi, accounts-role-filter, accounts-status-filter, accounts-search, edit-account-{id}, edit-account-modal, submit-edit-account, delete-account-{id}, delete-confirm-modal, confirm-delete-button. The /api/stats (not /api/dashboard/stats) is the correct endpoint if future testing touches dashboard stats.
rca of the issue: N/A — no app issues. One test failure was a stale endpoint name in my pytest.
